title: New Saga
description: Tsuyokute New SagaAfter a brutal war, magic swordsman Kyle defeats the Demon King but is left dying. A crimson crystal sends him four years into the past to his once-destroyed hometown where he finds his lost loved ones alive. Armed with future knowledge, Kyle vows to prevent the coming tragedy and rewrite fate.

episodes_data.description: Kyle is sent back in time after his fateful fight with the demon king and swears to save the world this time.

episodes_data.title: New Saga Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Kyle sets about making preparations for his heroic journey and the fight to come.

episodes_data.title: New Saga Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Kyle reunites with some old companions in new ways before making his first major play to change the future.

episodes_data.title: New Saga Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: To save the ill-fated Princess Milena, Kyle must brave a danger the likes of which he's never faced before.

episodes_data.title: New Saga Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Old friends become enemies as Kyle comes up with a plan to get Princess Milena to safety.

episodes_data.title: New Saga Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Kyle's party is celebrated for rescuing the princess, but they're given no time to rest on their laurels.
